source_description: Fiscal discount and VAT privilege detail classifications supplied from approved Central PMS facts.

code_sets.description: Classification of a fiscal discount or privilege detail, separate from entitlement type and reporting classification.

codes.description: An approved statutory fiscal detail carrying a discount amount and VAT privilege amount calculated by Central PMS; this code does not determine eligibility or recalculate either amount.

notes: The fiscal detail type describes the combined statutory discount and VAT privilege facts for current supported statutory issuance; FREE_PARKING remains the distinct benefit classification.
